articles.title: N-able patches max severity N-central flaw amid ongoing attacks
articles.executive_summary: N-able's N-central RMM platform has a maximum-severity RCE flaw, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely. An emergency hotfix has been released to patch the vulnerability, amid ongoing attacks.
articles.technical_breakdown: The flaw allows attackers to exploit a remote code execution vulnerability, executing arbitrary code on the affected system. The issue is attributed to a software bug that has been addressed in the emergency hotfix.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the emergency hotfix provided by N-able
Review and update network containment or firewall rules to block suspicious traffic
Monitor system logs for signs of exploitation and implement detection indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: N-able's N-central RMM platform has a max-severity RCE flaw, patched with an emergency hotfix. Apply the hotfix and review network rules to mitigate ongoing attacks.

articles.title: Critical MikroTik Vulnerability - Patch Now
articles.executive_summary: A critical vulnerability in MikroTik devices allows SSH authentication bypass, enabling attackers to maintain access even after patching. Affected devices should be patched immediately to prevent compromise.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability allows attackers to bypass SSH authentication, granting them access to affected devices. Attackers have been adding new accounts to maintain access after patching.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patch from MikroTik
Revoke and reissue SSH keys
Monitor for suspicious account activity
articles.telegram_snippet: Critical MikroTik vulnerability allows SSH authentication bypass, enabling attackers to maintain access after patching. Patch now to prevent compromise.

articles.title: MikroTik Routers Hijacked Through Exposed SSH Without Authentication
articles.executive_summary: Attackers are exploiting MikroTik routers with exposed SSH services to gain full administrative control without authentication, posing a significant operational risk. Successful attacks have been reported since at least September 2.
articles.technical_breakdown: Attackers are targeting MikroTik routers with internet-exposed SSH services, which are not configured with authentication, allowing them to gain full administrative control. This is likely due to a misconfiguration or lack of security best practices.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure SSH services are not exposed to the internet or configure authentication
Implement network segmentation and access controls
Monitor for suspicious login attempts and log monitoring indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: MikroTik routers are being hijacked through exposed SSH services without authentication, posing a significant operational risk. Ensure SSH services are not exposed to the internet or configure authentication to prevent attacks.

articles.title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
articles.executive_summary: Attackers are exploiting an unpatched zero-day vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce to run malicious code on online stores' servers without logging in, posing a significant operational risk to affected e-commerce businesses.
articles.technical_breakdown: The StyleSmuggler vulnerability allows attackers to execute malicious code on an online store's server without authentication, leveraging a previously unknown flaw in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce.
actionable_mitigations: Apply patches as soon as they become available
Implement network segmentation and firewall rules to contain potential lateral movement
Monitor logs for suspicious activity and implement detection indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day exploited to backdoor online stores, attackers can run malicious code without logging in, apply patches ASAP.

articles.title: Attackers conceal phishing lures using invisible Unicode characters
articles.executive_summary: Threat actors are using invisible Unicode characters to evade email security filters in phishing campaigns, posing a significant risk to organizations. This technique, known as ASCII smuggling, can lead to successful phishing attacks if not detected.
articles.technical_breakdown: Threat actors are utilizing invisible Unicode characters to conceal phishing lures, making it challenging for email security filters to detect the malicious content. This technique exploits the limitations of email security filters, allowing the phishing campaign to bypass detection.
actionable_mitigations: Implement additional email security filters that can detect invisible Unicode characters
Educate users on the risks of phishing attacks and the importance of verifying sender information
Monitor email traffic for suspicious activity and implement detection and log monitoring indicators
articles.telegram_snippet: Threat actors are using invisible Unicode characters to evade email security filters in phishing campaigns, posing a significant risk to organizations. Implement additional email security filters and educate users to mitigate this threat.

articles.title: Four REVSTEALER-Linked Modules Disable Windows Update and Defender to Run a Crypto Miner
articles.threat_category: Ransomware | Data Breach | 0-Day & Exploit | Nation-State/APT | Cloud & Supply Chain | Vulnerability / Advisory
articles.executive_summary: REVSTEALER-linked modules disable Windows Update and Defender to run a cryptocurrency miner, posing a significant operational risk. Infected machines remain vulnerable to further exploitation.
articles.technical_breakdown: The modules, ProManager, WinUpdate, SoftManager, and others, remain on the infected machine after the stealer deletes itself, allowing for continued exploitation. One module disables Windows Update and Microsoft Defender before running a cryptocurrency miner.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure Windows Update and Defender are enabled and up-to-date
Implement network containment or firewall rules to block suspicious traffic
Monitor system logs for signs of exploitation
articles.telegram_snippet: REVSTEALER-linked modules disable Windows Update and Defender to run a cryptocurrency miner, posing a significant operational risk to infected machines.

articles.title: ChatGPT Astra Rolled Out to $20 Plus Subscription, Free Users Left Waiting
articles.executive_summary: OpenAI has rolled out ChatGPT Astra to $20 Plus subscribers, leaving free users without access. This move may impact businesses relying on ChatGPT for tasks and operations.
articles.technical_breakdown: ChatGPT Astra is OpenAI's most powerful model to date, but the rollout to free users is uncertain. The lack of access for free users may be due to revenue generation strategies.
actionable_mitigations: Review and adjust business reliance on ChatGPT for tasks and operations
Consider upgrading to $20 Plus subscription for access to ChatGPT Astra
articles.telegram_snippet: OpenAI rolls out ChatGPT Astra to $20 Plus subscribers, leaving free users without access. Businesses relying on ChatGPT may need to adjust their operations.
